item.title: Craven County schools closed Monday, remote learning Tuesday
item.description: CRAVEN COUNTY, N.C. (WNCT) -- Due to the severe weather, Craven County Schools will be closed for students and staff on Monday, Feb. 2. On Tuesday, Feb. 3, schools will have an asynchronous learning day, completing work from home with no live instruction.
